author: core_review

baseline.description: Preceding implementation/evidence commit, not a released version claim

read_helpers: current_instance(conn,scope) -> current six-field tuple, never latest historical candidate
contract.v1: Default signature retains V1 stop-only table/owner. Nondefault handoff/callback options refuse. No online upgrade or mixed-schema fallback.
contract.v2: Fresh gen0 uses permanent root anchor plus create-only instance-<generation>-<48hex ID>.lock owner below anchor. Both leases revalidated. V2 schema removes scope uniqueness from history and adds generation/predecessor, UNIQUE(scope,generation), UNIQUE(predecessor). Scope-head primary key is sole current authority.
contract.head: controller_scope_heads(scope PK,current_id UNIQUE,generation,pending_grant BINARY). Pending grants remain observable but invalidate old live context admission. Every context row read also matches head(id,generation,NULL).
contract.identity: V2 schema2 adds generation, predecessor, derived owner_directory, anchor_directory/dev/ino/metadata SHA; original scope/database/host/boot/process remain bound. No supplied arbitrary owner path is trusted.
contract.successor: Lazy root _validated_admission returns a strong admission; exact target/source/grant IDs, generation, root anchor and actual current process are checked. One BEGIN IMMEDIATE: exact source pending head CAS -> target instance INSERT -> session_registrar -> admission.consume. Fresh connection rechecks instance/head and admission.verify_consumed. Root session separately reads its complete committed session row.
contract.callback: Trusted internal session_registrar only inserts bounded same-transaction metadata; no OS work, waiting or context polling before registration commit.
contract.failure: Unknown namespace/SQL/commit leaves strong context and owned directories held. No root or old generation lock release, age takeover, global reset or retry capability.

groups: fresh V2 exact identity/head and same-writer session callback
V1 schema/no migration and original owner preservation
fake admissions and malformed explicit protocol refuse before reservation
missing head/foreign unique index/head trigger refusal (3)
tests.boundary: Actual isolated Python exec/SQLite/own filesystem namespace. Uses existing pidfd-cleaned registration fixture; no real GPU/provider/host scan. No fake successful handoff capability is used.

tool_error.reason: Initial read included nonexistent tests/test_controller_registration.py after successfully reading registration_boundaries; file discovery then selected actual test_controller_control.py. Read-command error only; not a pytest/setup failure.

limits: Real authenticated successor admission, grant consume/channel handshake and two-controller product flow are root/runtime work and were not executed by this author in these runs.
V2 fresh registration/schema/head mechanisms do not themselves grant stop, restart or workload recovery.
Root handoff protocol will enforce its finite successor bound (initially 64); SQL/context only impose nonnegative signed-64-bit generation bounds.
Current-instance observation alone does not mean ACTIVE or execution authorization; pending/HOLD must be rejected by the caller/context.
Historical ownership and task/claim eligibility remain explicit; this implementation does not erase old rows, reset old claims or import old private process owners.
No whole Core/Pro aggregate is claimed; all listed runs overlap and counts must not be summed.
